{
  "name": "vkazas-ticker",
  "displayName": "Ticker",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A live stock pane (/ticker): a scrolling tape, prices, day change and an intraday sparkline for your watchlist, from Yahoo Finance.",
  "author": {
    "name": "VkaZas",
    "url": "https://github.com/VkaZas"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/VkaZas/claude-code-mods/tree/main/vkazas-ticker",
  "repository": "https://github.com/VkaZas/claude-code-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "pane",
    "stocks",
    "ticker",
    "finance"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "refresh": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresh (seconds) / 刷新间隔（秒）",
      "description": "How often to fetch quotes while the pane is open / 面板打开时多久拉一次行情",
      "options": [
        "5",
        "10",
        "30",
        "60"
      ],
      "default": "10"
    },
    "colors": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Up and down colors / 涨跌配色",
      "description": "us: green up, red down; cn: red up, green down / us：绿涨红跌；cn：红涨绿跌",
      "options": [
        "us",
        "cn"
      ],
      "default": "us"
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language / 语言",
      "description": "en: English; zh: 中文",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "zh"
      ],
      "default": "en"
    }
  }
}
